defaults.description: Applied to every database that does not override the field.

namespace.description: Namespace the PostgresDatabase is created in. Defaults to the release namespace.

annotations.description: Annotations set on the PostgresDatabase. argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options defaults to Prune=false,Delete=false.

name.description: Names the PostgresDatabase, which is created as <name>-database.

resourceName.description: Overrides the PostgresDatabase name. Defaults to <name>-database.

databaseName.description: Postgres database name. Defaults to name with dashes replaced by underscores.

roleName.description: Owning role. Defaults to the controller's choice.

additionalDatabases.description: Extra databases owned by the same role.

secretName.description: Secret holding the connection details. Defaults to <name>-database-secret.

secretNamespace.description: Namespace of the secret. Defaults to namespace.
